Class JsonNumber

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Number
gate.lang.json.JsonNumber
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonElement, JsonScalar, Serializable
public class JsonNumber extends Number implements JsonElement, JsonScalar
Represents a JSON number as a BigDecimal.
Author:
Davi Nunes da Silva
